limits: Absolute paths identify this host and worktree; raw databases remain in ignored workspace scratch on the measured SSD.
Harness records at most 50 surfaced errors per worker. Zero is unambiguous; nonzero values would not be exact total failure counts.
Harness ignores typed version_conflict; private per-worker entities avoid intentional version competition. Row and version consistency checked independently.
Reader failure count is derived from readerSamples minus successful latency sample count, because harness omits failed read latencies from percentiles.
Reported checkpointMs times a second checkpoint after an earlier untimed reader.db.pragma(TRUNCATE); it is not a trustworthy first-checkpoint duration and is not used for acceptance.
SQLITE_BUSY absence means none surfaced to the harness; internal production retry counts are not instrumented.
Observed WAL peaks over short runs and zero post-checkpoint bytes are not a long-duration WAL-growth proof.
Crash probes test process death, not host power loss or SSD/controller power-loss protection.

import json,os,subprocess,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(Path('/tmp/p4-output-path.txt').read_text());cwd=Path('/tmp/alix-srap-p4')
node='/tmp/alix-p4-runtime/node-v26.11.0-linux-x64/bin/node'
env={**os.environ,'BENCH_STORAGE_LABEL':'physical-nvme-ssd-ext4-INTEL-SSDPEKNW010T8'}
all_runs=[]
for mode in ['sustained','burst','session']:
 for repeat in range(1,4):
  name=f'{mode}-{repeat}';out=root/name
  args=[node,'scripts/benchmark-runtime-ledger-workloads.mjs','--writers','4','--seconds','20','--mode',mode,'--out',str(out)]
  if mode=='burst': args+=['--burst','25','--bursts','40']
  if mode=='session': args+=['--session-k','6','--think-ms','1500']
  if (root/f'{name}.json').exists():
   started=None
   data=json.loads((root/f'{name}.json').read_text())
  else:
   started=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime())
   run=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
   (root/f'{name}.stderr.log').write_text(run.stderr)
   if run.returncode: raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed {run.returncode}: {run.stderr[-1500:]}')
   data=json.loads(run.stdout);(root/f'{name}.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
  verify=subprocess.run([node,'/tmp/p4-verify-ledger.mjs',str(out/'runtime.db')],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
  integrity=json.loads(verify.stdout);(root/f'{name}.integrity.json').write_text(verify.stdout)
  assert integrity['events']['count']==data['totalAppends']==integrity['events']['uniqueEvents']==integrity['outbox']
  assert integrity['events']['minSeq']==1 and integrity['events']['maxSeq']==data['totalAppends']
  assert integrity['entities']==4 and not integrity['entityMismatches'] and not integrity['foreignKeyErrors'] and not integrity['orphanEvents'] and not integrity['orphanOutbox']
  assert integrity['integrity']==[{'integrity_check':'ok'}]
  reader_errors=data['readerSamples']-data['readerLatencyMs']['count']
  entry={'id':name,'startedAtUtc':started,'command':args,'measurement':data,'verification':integrity,'readerErrors':reader_errors}
  all_runs.append(entry)
  (root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(all_runs,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'run':name,'writesPerSec':data['aggregateWritesPerSec'],'appends':data['totalAppends'],'appendP95Ms':data['appendLatency']['p95'],'readerP95Ms':data['readerLatencyMs']['p95'],'errors':data['errorCount'],'readerErrors':reader_errors,'workerFailures':data['workerFailures'],'integrity':'ok'}),flush=True)
print('ALL NINE RUNS COMPLETED',flush=True)
